title: Ephesians Chapter 5 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Ephesians chapter 5 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Ephesians Chapter 5 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Ephesians Chapter 5.

questions.question: In Ephesians 5, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
questions.correctAnswer: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
questions.explanation: This is the first command in Ephesians 5, as stated in Ephesians 5:1.

questions.question: What are believers encouraged to walk in, according to Ephesians 5?
questions.explanation: Believers are encouraged to walk in love, as stated in Ephesians 5:2.

questions.question: What should not be named among saints, as per Ephesians 5?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:3 specifically states that fornication should not be named among saints.

questions.question: What is said to be more appropriate than filthiness and foolish talking?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:4 indicates that rather than filthiness and foolish talking, giving of thanks is appropriate.

questions.question: Who has no inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:5 states that whoremongers and certain other individuals have no inheritance in the kingdom.

questions.question: What should no man do, according to Ephesians 5?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:6 warns that no man should deceive you with vain words.

questions.question: What are believers advised against in Ephesians 5?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:7 advises believers not to be partakers with the children of disobedience.

questions.question: What were believers once, as described in Ephesians 5?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:8 states that believers were sometimes darkness.

questions.question: What is the fruit of the Spirit according to Ephesians 5?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:9 mentions that the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness.

questions.question: What are believers encouraged to prove in Ephesians 5?
options: What is acceptable unto the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: What is acceptable unto the Lord
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:10 encourages believers to prove what is acceptable unto the Lord.

questions.question: What should believers have no fellowship with, according to Ephesians 5?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:11 instructs believers to have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness.

questions.question: Is it true that believers are encouraged to walk in love?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:2 encourages believers to walk in love.

questions.question: Is it true that saints should not let fornication be named among them?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:3 states that fornication should not be named among saints.

questions.question: Is it false that the text mentions the need for foolish talking?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:4 mentions that foolish talking is not convenient.

questions.question: Is it false that the text mentions believers can partake with the children of disobedience?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:7 advises believers not to partake with the children of disobedience.

medium.title: Ephesians Chapter 5 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Ephesians Chapter 5 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 5:12, why is it considered shameful to speak of certain things?
options: Because they are done in secret
Because they are commanded by God
questions.correctAnswer: Because they are done in secret
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:12 states it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret, highlighting the shamefulness due to their secretive nature.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 5:14 promise will happen if someone 'awake' and 'arise from the dead' as commanded in verse 13?
options: You shall be filled with the Spirit
You shall walk as children of light
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:14 says, 'Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light,' indicating the promise that Christ will give light when one awakens and arises as in verse 13.

questions.question: What does walking 'circumspectly' mean according to Ephesians 5:15?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:15 instructs to 'walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,' meaning to walk wisely and carefully.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 5:16 relate to verse 15 about walking circumspectly?
options: Because days are evil, one should redeem the time
Because days are evil, one should be foolish
Because days are good, one should waste time
Because days are evil, one should be drunk
questions.correctAnswer: Because days are evil, one should redeem the time
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:16 explains that the reason to walk circumspectly is to redeem the time because the days are evil, connecting the wisdom in verse 15 to practical action in verse 16.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 5:18, what is one commanded not to be filled with?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:18 commands, 'And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit,' identifying wine as what one should avoid being filled with.

questions.question: What is the positive alternative to being drunk with wine in Ephesians 5:18?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:18 contrasts drunkenness with being filled with the Spirit as the proper conduct.

questions.question: What kinds of songs does Ephesians 5:19 encourage Christians to speak and sing?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:19 instructs speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 5:20, how should Christians give thanks?
options: Always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ
questions.correctAnswer: Always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:20 calls for giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in Jesus' name.

questions.question: What attitude does Ephesians 5:21 encourage believers to have toward one another?
options: Submitting one to another in the fear of God
questions.correctAnswer: Submitting one to another in the fear of God
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:21 commands believers to submit themselves one to another in the fear of God.

questions.question: In Ephesians 5:22, to whom are wives instructed to submit?
options: Their own husbands, as unto the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Their own husbands, as unto the Lord
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:22 clearly instructs wives to submit to their own husbands as to the Lord.

questions.question: Why does Ephesians 5:17 urge believers not to be unwise?
options: So they may understand the will of the Lord
So they can be praised by others
questions.correctAnswer: So they may understand the will of the Lord
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:17 says, 'be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is,' linking wisdom with knowing God's will.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 5:13 say is made manifest by the light?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:13 states that all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 5:20, in whose name should thanks be given to God the Father?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:20 instructs giving thanks in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

questions.question: True or False: Ephesians 5:21 encourages believers to submit to one another in the fear of God.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:21 states, 'Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God,' confirming mutual submission is encouraged.

questions.question: True or False: Ephesians 5:18 advises Christians to be drunk with wine to be filled with the Spirit.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:18 explicitly says, 'And be not drunk with wine... but be filled with the Spirit,' forbidding drunkenness.

hard.title: Ephesians Chapter 5 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Ephesians Chapter 5.

questions.question: Who is the head of the wife according to Ephesians 5:23?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:23 states that 'the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church.'

questions.question: What should wives be to their husbands in everything according to Ephesians 5:24?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:24 indicates that 'the wives be to their own husbands in every thing,' highlighting the call for submission.

questions.question: How are husbands instructed to love their wives in Ephesians 5:25?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:25 commands husbands to 'love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church.'

questions.question: What does Ephesians 5:28 say about how men should love their wives?
options: As a father loves his children
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:28 states, 'So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies.'

questions.question: What does Ephesians 5:30 say about the relationship between Christ and the church?
options: They are members of His body
questions.correctAnswer: They are members of His body
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:30 declares, 'For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.'

questions.question: According to Ephesians 5:31, what happens when a man leaves his father and mother?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:31 states, 'For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife.'

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'agape' in Ephesians 5:25 mean?
questions.explanation: 'Agape' refers to the unconditional love that is selfless, sacrificial, and unconditional, as emphasized in Ephesians 5:25.

questions.question: What literary device is used in Ephesians 5:32 when referring to the relationship of Christ and the church?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:32 uses metaphor to compare the union of husband and wife to the relationship between Christ and the church.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects with the theme of husbands loving their wives as Christ loved the church?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:19 states, 'Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them,' echoing the theme found in Ephesians 5:25.

questions.question: Which other passage emphasizes the submission of wives to their husbands?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:1 says, 'Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands,' connecting with the theme of Ephesians 5:24.

questions.question: What comes before Ephesians 5:24?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:23 precedes Ephesians 5:24, which discusses the relationship of husbands and wives.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 5:19 encourage believers to do?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:19 encourages believers to 'Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs.'

questions.question: According to Ephesians 5:18, believers are instructed to be filled with what?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:18 contrasts being drunk with wine with the instruction to 'be filled with the Spirit.'

questions.question: True or False: Ephesians 5:32 states that the union between husband and wife is a great mystery regarding Christ and the church.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:32 says, 'This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church,' confirming the statement.

questions.question: True or False: Ephesians 5:30 mentions that we are members of His body.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:30 indeed states, 'For we are members of his body,' so the statement is, in fact, true.

theological.title: Ephesians Chapter 5 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Ephesians Chapter 5 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 5:2 teach about sanctification?
options: Sanctification is rooted in walking in love as Christ loved us
Sanctification is achieved by law-keeping and ritual purity
Sanctification is based on human effort and moral improvement
Sanctification depends on abstaining from all social interaction
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctification is rooted in walking in love as Christ loved us
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:2 commands believers to walk in love, as Christ loved us and gave Himself as a sacrifice, indicating sanctification is grounded in Christlike love.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 5:5 teach about inheritance in the kingdom of God?
options: Those practicing covetousness and uncleanness have no inheritance in Christ's kingdom
Inheritance is guaranteed to all who profess faith regardless of conduct
Inheritance depends on social status and ethnicity
Inheritance is based on observance of Jewish ceremonial laws
questions.correctAnswer: Those practicing covetousness and uncleanness have no inheritance in Christ's kingdom
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:5 clearly states that no immoral or covetous person who is an idolater has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.

questions.question: What doctrine about the role of husbands does Ephesians 5:25 teach?
options: Husbands are to love their wives sacrificially as Christ loved the church
Husbands have absolute authority and wives must obey without question
Husbands should prioritize social honor over love in marriage
Husbands and wives have equal leadership with no distinctions
questions.correctAnswer: Husbands are to love their wives sacrificially as Christ loved the church
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:25 commands husbands to love their wives as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her, showing a doctrine of sacrificial love.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ephesians 5:14 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:14 calls the spiritually asleep to awake and arise that Christ might give light, demonstrating God's merciful initiative to bring spiritual illumination.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ephesians 5:18 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:18 exhorts believers to be filled with the Spirit rather than wine, showing the Spirit’s sanctifying power in the believer’s life.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 5:21–24 connect to broader biblical teaching on church and family order?
options: It reflects the submission of the church to Christ mirrored in the wife's submission to her husband
It teaches absolute patriarchy with no reciprocal responsibilities
It elevates wives above husbands as a new covenant innovation
It rejects all hierarchical structures in favor of egalitarianism
questions.correctAnswer: It reflects the submission of the church to Christ mirrored in the wife's submission to her husband
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:22–24 compares the wife's submission to her husband with the church's submission to Christ, connecting family order to the church’s relationship with Christ.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 5:31–32 relate to the theme of Christ and the church throughout Scripture?
options: It reveals marriage as a profound mystery illustrating Christ’s union with the church
It describes marriage as a purely social contract unrelated to theology
It teaches that only literal marriage can reflect Christ’s relationship with believers
It denies any typological connection between marriage and Christ's relationship with the church
questions.correctAnswer: It reveals marriage as a profound mystery illustrating Christ’s union with the church
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:31–32 calls the union of husband and wife a great mystery, explaining it symbolizes Christ’s relationship with the church, a major biblical theme.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ephesians 5:3 and 5:6 teach about Christian conduct and divine wrath?
options: Unrepentant immorality leads to God's wrath, and believers must avoid complicity
God’s wrath is arbitrary and unrelated to human conduct
Christian conduct is irrelevant to salvation and divine wrath
Believers are free to engage in works of darkness if secret
questions.correctAnswer: Unrepentant immorality leads to God's wrath, and believers must avoid complicity
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:3 forbids immoral behavior among saints, and 5:6 warns that God’s wrath comes because of such deeds, urging believers not to partake in them.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ephesians 5:8 and 5:9 teach about the believer's new identity and sanctification?
options: Believers are called from darkness to light and produce the fruit of the Spirit
Believers remain in darkness but are justified by works
Sanctification is unrelated to new identity in Christ
Fruit of the Spirit is optional for true believers
questions.correctAnswer: Believers are called from darkness to light and produce the fruit of the Spirit
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:8 states believers were darkness but now light, and 5:9 identifies the fruit of the Spirit as goodness, righteousness, and truth, showing sanctification as transformation.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ephesians 5:28 and 5:29 teach about the nature of the husband’s love for his wife?
options: Husbands must love their wives as their own bodies, nourishing and cherishing them
Husbands should prioritize themselves over their wives
Love in marriage is purely emotional and not related to care
Husbands ought to love their wives only conditionally
questions.correctAnswer: Husbands must love their wives as their own bodies, nourishing and cherishing them
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:28-29 teaches husbands are to love their wives as their own bodies, nourishing and cherishing them as the Lord does the church.

questions.question: Skeptics claim Ephesians 5:18–20 promotes legalistic worship practices. What does this passage actually teach?
options: It teaches believers to be filled with the Spirit, engaging in joyful, Spirit-led worship
It mandates strict ritualistic acts to earn God’s favor
It prohibits spontaneous praise and only allows prescribed hymns
It teaches that wine and intoxication are spiritually acceptable
questions.correctAnswer: It teaches believers to be filled with the Spirit, engaging in joyful, Spirit-led worship
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:18–20 contrasts drunkenness with being Spirit-filled, emphasizing Spirit-led singing and thanksgiving, not legalistic ritualism.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 5:21 teach about Christian community life?
options: Mutual submission among believers rooted in reverence for God
Submission only of wives to husbands
questions.correctAnswer: Mutual submission among believers rooted in reverence for God
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:21 commands submitting to one another out of reverence for Christ, teaching mutual submission as fundamental to Christian community.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ephesians 5:27 specifically demonstrate in the context of the church’s sanctification?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:27 emphasizes Christ presenting the church holy and without blemish, highlighting God’s attribute of holiness in sanctification.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 5:15–16 prepare believers for living in a fallen world?
options: By urging circumspect, wise living and redeeming the time because the days are evil
By encouraging indulgence since the world is corrupt
By commanding withdrawal from all social interaction
By promising immediate escape from evil days without responsibility
questions.correctAnswer: By urging circumspect, wise living and redeeming the time because the days are evil
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:15–16 exhorts believers to live wisely and make the most of time amid evil days, preparing them to engage faithfully in a fallen world.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ephesians 5:26 and 5:30 teach about the church’s relationship to Christ?
options: The church is sanctified and cleansed by Christ as members of His body, flesh, and bones
The church is an unrelated institution to Christ’s person
Sanctification is achieved by human effort without Christ
The church is only a metaphor with no real union to Christ
questions.correctAnswer: The church is sanctified and cleansed by Christ as members of His body, flesh, and bones
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:26 speaks of Christ sanctifying the church by the word, and 5:30 reveals believers as members of His body, emphasizing intimate union and sanctification.
